replacements.NLP antes del Transformer: tres enfoques: NLP before the Transformer: three approaches, one common limit
replacements.Durante cuatro décadas el procesamiento: For four decades, natural-language processing was built on statistics and sequences. Each approach was a real advance, yet shared the same underlying limit: context was lost.
replacements.N-gramas: predecir la siguiente palabra: N-grams: predict the next word from local context
replacements.Un modelo de N-gramas estima la probabil: An N-gram model estimates the probability of a word using only the immediately preceding fragment. A trigram looks at the previous two words. This was a foundation of speech recognition and statistical machine translation for decades.
replacements.«El gato que compró mi vecina el martes: "The cat that my neighbor bought on Tuesday eats ___" depends on "cat", nine words away. A trigram cannot reach it: it only sees two words back.
replacements.HMM: las etiquetas como estados que gene: HMM: labels as states that generate words
replacements.Los Modelos Ocultos de Markov tratan las: Hidden Markov Models treat grammatical categories as unobserved states that generate visible words. The Viterbi algorithm infers the most probable state sequence. HMMs dominated speech recognition and part-of-speech tagging for two decades.
replacements.asume que cada palabra depende solo de s: it assumes each word depends only on its current state, not on global context. Long-range dependencies and semantic ambiguity remain outside its reach.
replacements.CRF: modelar la etiqueta directamente, c: CRF: model the label directly, with hand-engineered features
replacements.Los Campos Aleatorios Condicionales mejo: Conditional Random Fields improved on HMMs by directly modeling P(labels | words) and allowing arbitrary contextual features. They were state of the art for named-entity recognition until neural networks displaced them.
replacements.las features deben diseñarse a mano. No: the features must be designed by hand. There is no representation of meaning: "bank" (financial institution) and "bank" (river bank) are distinguished by context, but the CRF has no such semantic layer.
replacements.Lo que los tres enfoques no podían hacer: What the three approaches could not do
replacements.N-gramas, HMM y CRF fueron avances reale: N-grams, HMMs and CRFs were real advances, each building on the previous one. But all three shared the same underlying limitation: context was processed locally and representations were designed by hand. The Transformer addressed exactly those two fronts.
replacements.Contexto limitado a ventana local o esta: Context limited to a local window or current state
replacements.Un modelo distinto para cada tarea: A different model for each task
replacements.Atención sobre el contexto completo de l: Attention over the full sequence context
replacements.Embeddings con información semántica y p: Embeddings with semantic and positional information
replacements.Un modelo base, múltiples tareas con fin: One base model, multiple tasks through fine-tuning
replacements.el campo no abandonó la estadística, sin: the field did not abandon statistics; instead, it stopped requiring humans to design the representations. Representation itself became something the model learned.
